name: net.http.hpack
doc:
HPACK (RFC 7541), the header compression of HTTP/2: the static table,
a dynamic table per direction, integer and string literals, Huffman
coding (the C helpers rtHuff* in runtime/src/std_http.c). Decoder and
Encoder each keep the state of one direction of one connection.

items.name: Decoder
items.doc: Decoder decodes the header blocks of one direction of a connection.
items.summary: Decoder decodes the header blocks of one direction of a connection.

members.name: Decode
members.doc: Decodes one complete header block (HEADERS + CONTINUATION payloads).
members.summary: Decodes one complete header block (HEADERS + CONTINUATION payloads).

members.name: SetMaxTableSize
members.doc: Changes the limit announced in SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE.
members.summary: Changes the limit announced in SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE.

members.name: TableSize
members.doc: The current dynamic table size (bytes, RFC 7541 4.1) and entry count.
members.summary: The current dynamic table size (bytes, RFC 7541 4.1) and entry count.

items.name: Encoder
items.doc: Encoder encodes the header blocks of one direction of a connection.
items.summary: Encoder encodes the header blocks of one direction of a connection.

members.name: Huffman
members.doc: Huffman-code strings when shorter (default on via NewEncoder)
members.summary: Huffman-code strings when shorter (default on via NewEncoder)

members.name: Encode
members.doc: Encodes fields into one header block.
members.summary: Encodes fields into one header block.

members.name: SetMaxTableSize
members.doc:
Changes the table size (the peer's SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE, or
less); the next block starts with a size update.
members.summary: Changes the table size (the peer's SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE, or less); the next block starts with a size update.

items.name: HeaderField
items.doc:
A header field. Sensitive fields are never indexed (encoded as
"literal never indexed", and kept so by intermediaries).

members.name: Size
members.doc: The table size of the entry (RFC 7541 4.1).
members.summary: The table size of the entry (RFC 7541 4.1).
